_: THE SWEEP THAT SAYS THE LOCAL COMPILE AND THE HOSTED ONE AGREE — run it from
the repository root:
cargo run -q --manifest-path tools/injection-harness/Cargo.toml -- sweep \
crates/mnemosyne-cli/sweeps/local-strictness.sweep.json
WHAT THE CONTRACT IS (Round 1342). Since Round 1287 the git hooks compile
nothing — deliberately, because Round 1284 measured a commit that could not
finish eleven times while sibling repositories held the cores — so the hosted
`cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` is the only judge of a warning and
its verdict arrives one round late. Round 1337 shipped two unused imports that
way: the job died on them and the eight steps behind it never ran. They were
never hidden; `scripts/mn` compiled that crate and printed both, to the round
that shipped them and again to the round that repaired them. So that one
compile — the one every hook already pays for — now carries the same
strictness, and a law asks the WORKFLOW what that strictness is rather than
spelling it twice.
TWO INJECTIONS, one per side of the agreement. Loosen the script and the law
must redden; loosen the workflow and it must redden too. A law that only reads
one side would pass while the two disagreed, which is the whole failure it
exists to prevent.
RUN IT LOCALLY. The harness edits this tree and writes the firing record
beside this file.

injections.name: the-local-build-stops-denying-warnings
injections.why: the state this repository was in until Round 1342: the one compile every hook pays for prints its warnings and exits 0, so a warning reaches `main` and is read a round later. This is the side a round loosens by accident, while trying to get past a warning it does not want to fix yet

injections.name: the-hosted-job-stops-denying-warnings
injections.why: the other side, and the reason the law reads the workflow instead of spelling the token: if CI loosens, a local build that is still strict is no longer AGREEING with anything — it is holding a rule nobody else holds, and the next person to hit it will loosen the script rather than ask why the two differ
